title: Cap set in F_3^8, lower bound
statement: Find as many points as possible in F_3^8 with no three distinct points on a line (no x + y + z = 0). The largest known cap set in dimension 8, by Romera-Paredes et al. (2023, FunSearch), has 512 points; a larger one improves it.
submission: Text file: the points separated by whitespace, each as 8 digits 0-2 with nothing between them.
score: the number of points (larger is better)

best_known.source: r(8) >= 512: Romera-Paredes et al. (2023, FunSearch), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
